This document outlines the inspection 
checklist for electrical safety valve. There is one valve per unit. The major 
parts of the valve are (coil and a pressure switch). It is installed on the line 
of the main steam. The main target of it is to protect the main steam line from 
high pressure.

The switch will be closed and will 
supply the125 dc volt to the coil at a pressure of 144 kg/cm2 and the safety 
valve will be opened to decrease the high pressure. When the pressure decreases 
to 137 kg/cm2 the switch will be opened and disconnect the 125 dc volt to the 
coil, then the safety valve will be closed.

The first 
draft initiated by eng. Hazem Mohamed Gamal at 17 April 2005, submitted 
by eng. Ibrahim Hefny at 24 April 2005, reviewed by EDEPC quality control eng. 
Abdel Menem Al Emam, accepted by General Director eng. Hamdy Azab, and 
approved by eng. Fawzy Sobhy Ismael: head sector of Abu Sultan Power Plant.
